items.html: It turns out that from those discernments that are in the seven lower Nekudot, the Partzufim [pl. of Partzuf] of AA, of AVI, and of ZON were made after the correction, both in the discernments of the lights and in the discernment of the vessels. However, the discernments in them that are of Atik Yomin, these rose and mingled with the three first Nekudot, which are all the discernment of Atik Yomin; and from all these discernments the Partzuf of Atik was made, in the manner we shall explain.
